sentences: MoltenVK's SPIRV-Cross turns each `NoContraction` `OpFAdd`, `OpFSub` and `OpFMul` into a call to a `[[clang::optnone]]` helper (`spvFAdd`, `spvFSub`, `spvFMul`), and Metal does not inline it.
MoltenVK 1.4.2 and `main` up to at least `5189f8de` are affected.
SPIRV-Cross `98cbb7c0` inlines the helpers from MSL 3.2 with bit-identical output, and MoltenVK on macOS 26 or newer compiles MSL 4.0.
On an Apple M3 Max, a translated compute shader of `v_mul_f32`, `v_add_f32` and `v_sub_f32` in a loop took 7.6 to 15.7 times as long on the GPU with the optnone helpers as with `98cbb7c0`.

With independent operations and no `NoContraction`, it took two thirds of the `98cbb7c0` time, which is the cost of the decoration itself ([measurement](https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida/issues/1380#issuecomment-7078722086)).
The same `spvFMul` helper drops the sign of a -0 product (SHADER-182, #1376).
